purpose: Expose the Stage 6 dependency manifest to a bounded Project Doctor / Smart Regression selector so changed ConfigData and admitted frozen canonical inputs choose only the affected validation/page pipelines.

selectionPolicy.rawConfigData: Resolve the exact source path through the frozen Stage 2 sourceTypes table, then select only Stage 6 Stage 2 domains that explicitly list that source type.
selectionPolicy.stage2DomainArtifact: Select its owning domain from the Stage 6 manifest.
selectionPolicy.stage4CanonicalInput: Select only the explicitly allowlisted domains in canonicalImpact.
selectionPolicy.stage4DomainArtifact: Select its owning domain from the Stage 6 manifest.
selectionPolicy.otherLookupArtifact: Run ConfigData Lookup integrity only unless an owning page domain is explicitly known.

requiredChecks: Stage 6 predecessor remains PASS and its manifest is present
Stage 2 sourceTypes exactly cover the Stage 6 tracked raw ConfigData source paths
Stage 4 canonical inputs are all mapped to explicit known domains
all selected pipeline commands and workflow files exist
fixture impact plans cover Hero-only, Soldier-only, Equipment-only, shared Skill, canonical overlay, lookup-only, no-impact, and unknown-ConfigData fail-closed cases
pipeline execution is validation-only and command argv comes only from this frozen contract
no name JOIN, ID arithmetic, transitive relation discovery, canonical recomputation, or wall-clock metadata is introduced

nextStage.goal: Add further page domains or hosted QA targets only when their dependency ownership is explicitly frozen; do not infer new impact edges from filenames or names.
